summary: V2-06 phase 1 accepted. The candidate establishes the Research Analytics Plane architecture with zero modifications to existing product code. New additions: src/analytics/types.ts (Research Analytics Store types with zero operational IDs, zero free text, zero join keys — AnonymousTaskFact, AnonymousHouseholdAggregate, AnonymousCohortAggregate, ResearchDataProduct, DataProductProvenance, GeneralizedTimestamp, TaxonomyCategoryId), src/analytics/taxonomy.ts (TaskTaxonomyService v1.0.0 with deterministic case/accent-insensitive label-to-category mapping across 10 taxonomy categories), src/analytics/pipeline.ts (PrivacyTransformPipeline that rejects any input containing operational IDs, free text, or missing taxonomyCategoryId — validates all forbidden fields, generalizes timestamps to coarse dimensions, suppresses rare cells by cohort size), src/analytics/gate.ts (PrivacyReleaseGate that validates all external outputs for operational IDs, free text, minimum cohort sizes, rare cells, differencing/reconstruction risk, provenance metadata, and generates audit log entries), src/analytics/index.ts (module barrel export), src/infrastructure/local/LocalResearchAnalyticsAdapter.ts (disabled by default, emitFact is no-op when disabled), src/infrastructure/local/DisabledResearchAnalyticsAdapter.ts (permanently disabled no-op adapter for testing), __tests__/application/V2-06-acceptance.test.ts (155+ tests across 8 sections proving all V2-06 phase 1 criteria). The diff is purely additive: zero modifications to domain, application, features, or UI layers. Domain layer has zero references to analytics. Trusted verification passed (exit code 0): typecheck clean, 15 test suites, 465 tests green. No regression on V2-00..V2-05. Analytics is disabled by default and disabling it produces identical product behavior and zero test failures. All mustFix findings are resolved.
